sentences.en: We must be able to discriminate between objects and situations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须能够区分物体和情境。

sentences.en: Subtle differences in tone discriminate the original from the copy.
sentences.zh: 微妙的音调差异可以区分原版与复印件。

sentences.en: Don't discriminate against people based on nationality, gender, or occupation.
sentences.zh: 不要因为国籍、性别或职业而歧视他人。

senses.zh: 分别, 辨别, 区分
歧视, 有差别地对待
